content.title: Anthony Jones misses Nebraska spring game for best reason: He's a new dad
content.text: LINCOLN — Nebraska defensive end Anthony Jones missed Saturday's spring game to continuing celebrating the birth of he and wife Anu's child, coach Matt Rhule after the scrimmage.
